controls.name: decayS
controls.doc: The time the tail takes to fall 60 dB, seconds.

controls.name: lengthMs
controls.doc: The spring's delay, ms: the time of one trip along it, the first return.

controls.name: tensionPct
controls.doc: How hard the spring is drawn, percent: it sets the dispersion's corner from SPRING_CHIRP_HZ, and with it the drip of the low notes arriving after the high ones.

controls.name: dampHz
controls.doc: The loop's low-pass corner, Hz: the tail darkens as it falls.

controls.name: mixPct
controls.doc: The wet against the dry, percent. It comes up at 0, the input bit for bit.

SPRING_SECTIONS.doc: The first-order all-pass sections in the loop: enough of them and the low notes come later, the sound of a spring.

SPRING_CHIRP_HZ.doc: The all-pass sections' corner at a tension of 0 and of 100 %, Hz, moved linearly between.

SPRING_RIGHT_RATIO.doc: The right spring's length against the left's: two springs of different lengths, as a tank carries, so the legs decorrelate.

SPRING_LOOP_MAX.doc: The loop gain's ceiling: the tail always decays.
